<%*
const num  = await tp.system.prompt("Epic number (e.g. 1)");
const name = await tp.system.prompt("Hyphenated name (e.g. chat-context-management)");

if (!num || !name) { new Notice("Epic creation cancelled."); return; }

const id     = "EPIC-" + num.padStart(3, "0");
const folder = "backlog/" + id + "-" + name;
const title  = name.replace(/-/g, " ");
const today  = tp.date.now("YYYY-MM-DD");
const branch = "feat/" + id + "-" + name;
const fence  = String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3);

await tp.file.move(folder + "/epic");

const design = [
  "---",
  "id: " + id,
  "doc: design",
  "updated: " + today,
  "---",
  "",
  "# " + id + ": " + title + " — Master design",
  "",
  "← [[" + folder + "/epic|Back to epic]]",
  "",
  "Source of truth for the cross-cutting architecture of this epic. Member-task",
  "`design.md` files reference sections here instead of restating decisions.",
  "This document evolves in stages: a section appears only after its design is",
  "settled; anything still open is parked in «Open questions».",
  "",
  "## Solution overview",
  "",
  "One paragraph: the overall approach across the whole epic and why.",
  "",
  "## Architecture",
  "",
  fence + "mermaid",
  "graph TD",
  "    A[Component A] --> B[Component B]",
  fence,
  "",
  "## Foundational concepts",
  "",
  "Shared vocabulary and invariants every member task must respect.",
  "",
  "## Key decisions",
  "",
  "### Decision 1: Name",
  "",
  "**Context:** what problem we are solving across tasks.",
  "**Options:** Option A / Option B",
  "**Choice:** Option A, because... (ADR candidate: yes/no)",
  "",
  "## Open questions",
  "",
  "- [ ] Question 1"
].join("\n");

await tp.file.create_new(design, "design", false, folder);

tR += [
  "---",
  "id: " + id,
  "doc: epic",
  'title: "' + title + '"',
  "status: todo",
  "priority: medium",
  "branch: " + branch,
  "created: " + today,
  "updated: " + today,
  "tags: []",
  "---",
  "",
  "# " + id + ": " + title,
  "",
  "← [[" + folder + "/design|Master design]]",
  "",
  "## Goal / Outcomes",
  "",
  "One paragraph: the end state delivered by the whole epic and the user value.",
  "Bulleted outcomes that the member tasks collectively satisfy.",
  "",
  "## Delivery profile",
  "",
  "Fill before decomposition (`create-epic`). Downstream skills read this block.",
  "",
  "- **integration_strategy:** epic-branch        <!-- epic-branch | trunk-based | sequential-branches -->",
  "- **integration_boundary:** epic               <!-- task | checkpoint | epic -->",
  "- **decomposition_principle:** functional      <!-- functional (by IODA layer) | vertical-slice (e2e) -->",
  "- **internal_compat:** none                    <!-- between member tasks: none | additive | full -->",
  "- **external_contract:** none                    <!-- epic ↔ deployed state at merge: none | additive | migrate-on-merge -->",
  "- **branch:** `" + branch + "` — single shared branch (see [Shared branch](#shared-branch)); member-task `plan.md` `branch:` stays empty.",
  "",
  "> `internal_compat` governs states *between* member tasks. `external_contract` is a",
  "> separate horizon for already-deployed/persisted state at epic merge and is always",
  "> in force regardless of `internal_compat`.",
  "",
  "<!-- trunk-based: replace branch line with the per-task branch pattern (e.g. feat/TASK-NNN-slug, merged independently). -->",
  "<!-- sequential-branches: drop the branch line; add a Branch/Checkpoint column to the decomposition table and reference it here. -->",
  "",
  "## Shared branch",
  "",
  "All member tasks are implemented on a single branch: `" + branch + "`.",
  "Member-task `plan.md` `branch:` stays empty — `implement-task` resolves the",
  "branch from this epic (create on the first task, reuse afterwards).",
  "",
  "<!-- Omit for trunk-based or sequential-branches — branch mapping lives in Delivery profile. -->",
  "",
  "## Decomposition",
  "",
  "**Principle:** how the epic was cut (align with `decomposition_principle` above;",
  "e.g. by dependency layer, not by user-facing feature).",
  "",
  "<!-- sequential-branches / release-per-checkpoint: add a Branch (or Checkpoint) column to the table below -->",
  "",
  "| ID | Title | Size | Deliverable |",
  "|----|-------|------|-------------|",
  "| [[TASK-NNN-slug/task\\|TASK-NNN]] | title | S/M/L | what ships |",
  "",
  "**Dependency graph:**",
  "",
  fence + "mermaid",
  "graph TD",
  "    T1[TASK-NNN] --> T2[TASK-NNN]",
  fence,
  "",
  "**Milestone:** the point at which the epic delivers standalone user value.",
  "",
  "**Parallelisation:** which tasks are independent / can be picked up in any order.",
  "",
  "## Member tasks (live rollup)",
  "",
  fence + "dataviewjs",
  'const EPIC = "' + id + '";',
  "const statusLabel = {",
  '  "in-progress": "🔵 in-progress",',
  '  "in-review":   "🟣 in-review",',
  '  "blocked":     "🔴 blocked",',
  '  "todo":        "⬜ todo",',
  '  "done":        "✅ done"',
  "};",
  'const tasks = dv.pages(\'"backlog"\')',
  '  .where(p => p.file.name === "task" && p.epic === EPIC)',
  "  .sort(p => p.id);",
  "dv.table(",
  '  ["ID", "Title", "Link", "Status", "Priority", "Size"],',
  "  tasks.map(p => [",
  "    p.id,",
  "    p.title,",
  "    p.file.link,",
  "    statusLabel[p.status] ?? p.status,",
  "    p.priority,",
  "    p.size",
  "  ])",
  ");",
  fence,
  "",
  "## Notes",
  "",
  "<!-- Cross-task decisions made on the fly, sequencing changes, etc. -->"
].join("\n");
%>
